label: b99: F1 desktop bench (ngubeta0), seed 4 of 4, 40k steps ~1 h: rate and RSS of 4 ngu arms with the workers up
notes: Group F gate 5 for F1 (plans/algoExploration/f-ngu-agent57.md section 4): a 4-arm desktop wave of ngu at the F1 paper cell's exact settings (two arms at beta_max 0.3, two at the beta_max 0 control), 40k counted steps = ~1 h, with the stage-A queue and its 8 workers up, to measure the per-arm update rate under the wave's contention (fields: ngu.updates_per_s) and each arm's RSS (fields: ngu.rss_gb) at the 30,000-window replay. Laptop solo benchmark 2026-10-25: update 647 ms, k-NN reward 8 ms a step at 2,500 keys, 2.5 GB peak RSS with the buffer resident. The projection for b53 (130k updates) is corrected from this wave; if four arms plus the workers do not leave ~2 GB of the box's 15 GB free, b53 runs at 20,000 windows or in 2-arm waves.
